issue.title: CLI greeting should support a custom name
issue.body: When I run the greeting command, it always prints Hello, world. Add an option to use a custom name. Expected behavior: `greet --name Ada` prints `Hello, Ada`. Please add a test for the custom name and keep the default greeting unchanged.

readme:
# First Contribution Kit

A fictional Python command-line project used only for the bundled RepoGuide offline demo.

Run the greeting command with `python -m app.cli`. The current greeting is implemented in `src/cli.py`. Add regression coverage under `tests/` and see `CONTRIBUTING.md` for the project's contribution checklist.
